page: Microsoft Azure E96-48ds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Edsv6 family, virtualized via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz, configured with 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs at 2.0 threads per core. The CPU includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache, alongside hardware support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Memory capacity is 768.0 GB, providing 16.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes 5669 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, with no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory and processing capabilities. The server achieved a strong memory bandwidth read-only small block cached speed of 3723.24 GB/sec and a large block uncached read speed of 234.94 GB/sec, though large block write bandwidth was average at 84.9 GB/sec. CPU performance is highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 63798.65 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18862.0, both rated as strong. In specialized tasks, the server demonstrated top-tier performance in Geekbench image processing at 19373.0 and strong performance in software compilation at 44763.0. For database workloads, it achieved 67.4 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a strong PassMark database operations score of 24034.71.

With 768.0 GB of RAM and 5669 GB of local storage, this server offers high resource density for memory-intensive and data-heavy workloads. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck. However, a potential tradeoff is the average multi-core CPU performance relative to its high memory footprint, as well as average text generation speeds in LLM inference benchmarks. The server is highly suited for relational databases, Redis deployments, static web serving, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
